.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (whole file; known false positive 'One criterion covering a whole flow')

qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/manifest.json (functional judge.toml sha256 086fe253... and polish judge.toml sha256 1e8cf040... recomputed and matching) and raw-evidence-index.json (scripted golden only; no configured judge run)
evidence: All 50 criterion descriptions were read (38 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual, 3 gate). Most state one conjunctive bar closed by a 'Fails if' list, which the skill's whole-flow false positive and the workbook's internal note permit; flow bundling is not reported. Three instances leave the judge two targets. (1) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:308 cw_save_reload_restart requires 'After it reports a completed restart, a fresh page must show the same identity, revision, title, filename, source and history', then ends 'If the restart tool itself reports an error, state that the restart evidence is unavailable.' That sentence assigns no verdict. The frozen template resolves it explicitly (webdev-task-template/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:85-86 'If the tool reports an error, the persistence criterion fails'); this task's functional prompt.md:30 dropped that sentence, so the description can be read either as fail (restart legs unproven) or as pass on the reload and second-tab legs with a disclaimer. (2) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:173 cw_js_semantic_coloring states the bar as each of five categories having 'a visibly distinct treatment from plain identifiers', plus the function name 'differing from the keyword and string treatments', then 'Fails if two of those five categories share one treatment'. These are different bars: pairwise distinctness among the five is not demanded by the body, and sameness with plain identifiers is not in the fail list. The sibling at judge.toml:182 (HTML) is consistent. (3) tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus enumerates title, filename, Run, Stop, Save, Format, Find, Replace and library, then restricts to 'Each of these controls that the app offers' and closes 'A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere, not here' - an enumerate-then-waive shape; it is a deliberate conditional bar, so recorded as an instance at Note level rather than the basis of the Fail. Minor, Note level: several 'Fails if' lists are narrower than the 'must' legs above them (judge.toml:74 omits Shift+Tab outdent and Redo; :92 omits the Run output; :47 omits Shift+Arrow selection; :128 omits the readout; :155 omits Redo restoring four; :200 omits two-space nesting which :191 includes; :362 omits the unsaved indication). functional/prompt.md:12 ('A criterion is a conjunction: every step it lists must hold') and polish/prompt.md:67 resolve these toward the body, so they are not counted as failures, but aligning them would remove doubt. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope is scripted golden only), so how the judge resolves instances 1 and 2 is unmeasured.
counterexample: (1) Weak app passing: a submission that saves to the server but whose process does not come back after being stopped (or loses data on boot so readiness never arrives). restart_app reports an error; the judge has confirmed reload and second-tab reads, follows line 308 literally by writing 'restart evidence unavailable', and awards the 1.5-weight pass although the brief (behaviour.md:14 'saved work and history must survive a complete server restart') is unproven. A second judge fails the same app; the outcome depends on which target is chosen. (2) Conforming alternative failing: an editor that colours keywords, function names and strings distinctly and renders numbers and comments in one shared muted colour that differs from plain identifiers. It meets every 'must' in the body of line 173 but hits 'Fails if two of those five categories share one treatment'. Weak app passing the other way: strings drawn exactly like plain identifiers while the other four differ - the body bar fails, yet no listed fail condition is met.
suggested_fix: judge.toml:308 - replace the last sentence with a verdict, matching the template: 'If the restart tool reports an error, this criterion fails; say that the restart could not be completed.' judge.toml:173 - state one bar in both places, e.g. body 'the five categories must each have a treatment visibly distinct from plain identifiers and from one another' and 'Fails if any of the five looks the same as a plain identifier or as another of the five, ...' (or, if pairwise distinctness is not intended, change the fail clause to 'Fails if any of the five looks the same as a plain identifier, if the function name shares the keyword or string treatment, ...'). polish/judge.toml:23 - optionally name the bar once ('every control the app shows among ...') and drop the trailing waiver sentence; optionally extend the narrower 'Fails if' lists or end them with 'or if any step above does not hold'.
